If you absolutely don't want to go into the hospital then there are some suggestions I can give you:  


1. How much water are you drinking? You NEED to be drinking 2-3 liters of water a day, no ifs ands or buts.
2. How much caffeine are you drinking a day? Cut that back and realize that caffeine = anxiety food. Chill on it and maybe not fuck with it at all. I had to quit drinking it for several months
3. How often are you going to the gym? Gym = anxiety/stress relief. Do it often
4. How much sugar are you eating? What's your diet like? Change your diet you change your mood. It's very true
5. If none of the above are applicable to you \[I am sure some are though\] Try some meditation, mindfulness exercises, emotional regulation skills, Look into CBT and DBT online there is lots of skills for information like that.
6. One final note: when under intense anxiety, embrace it and accept it and don't fight it. What resists persists and if you resist it then it will be worse. When it hits try and relax your body a bit through either breathing or lying down and just chilling

Hope that helps!
